answer: Locks are entered in island, expire in fable, and nectar lists each expiry. Someone running 127 aliases therefore needs 100 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3262 identities would post 1624 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
